product_metadata.title: Now Designs Powder-Coated Steel Utensil Crock, Red
features: A decorative and convenient solution for overflowing drawers and crowded countertops. Keep all of your most-used utensils at an arm’s reach while keeping your kitchen organized and tidy.
Add a pop of color with this bright Red crock and it will bring a fresh look to your countertop while freeing up valuable space in your drawers.

Functional and useful, the front of the utensil crock features the phrase "Kitchen Utensils" and a drawing of a spoon, spatula and flipper. Organize your cutlery to come right to the table or to your counter with all you most used cooking utenslls

Made from food-safe powder-coated steel with a glossy finish. The polished appearance creates a subtle look that blends with almost any décor. A simple hand wash keeps this holder as an essential kitchen accessory for years to come.

Now Designs is a collection of kitchen and dining essentials designed to celebrate and support the joy of living well. Reimagined classics and an abundance of colors and tones to appeal to every taste.
description: Give your kitchen utensils a beautiful storage option. Overflowing with subtle style this Utensil Crock by Now Designs graces your counter or stovetop while wrangling your essential cooking tools to keep them close at hand for stirring, flipping or whisking. Lightweight powder-coated steel, this handy caddy fits all of your most-used cooking utensils. When you open the drawer and it is overflowing, select those that are your essential go-to tools and keep them findable and conveniently close. Made with powder-coated steel the glossy finish is designed to add that little extra to your countertop. The durable finish wipes clean, or a quick wash in the sink will have it ready to keep your kitchen organized again. Now Designs creates items that make your kitchen functional and add effortless style.
